description: Initial design defaults to test, not established performance claims. Admission enforces every limit here; the host's token or currency usage is reported as unknown when it is not exposed, never promised as a hard cap.
counting_rules: Every actual worker attempt and retry counts toward max_worker_tasks.
The root orchestrator is not a worker slot.
Managers, directors and fresh reviewers count when actually invoked.
A challenge round counts toward max_challenge_rounds; a risk-triggered challenge that does not fit requires explicit replanning or human approval to expand.
Crossing a limit returns a useful partial result and a specific request to expand scope. Never silently switch to deep mode or hide review work to fit a budget.

focused.target_use: Narrow research or a single-role output.

standard.target_use: Typical feature analysis or bounded prototype stage.

deep.target_use: Explicitly requested cross-team design or disputed decision.
